text: Hi, thanks for coming to meet with me. I’m working on a grant proposal for a project on the history of the Ottoman Empire and I could use some help. Sure, what can I do? Well, I need someone to help with the grant proposal. Do you have any experience with writing grant proposals? No, but I’m a quick learner and I’m willing to do whatever it takes to help out. Then this will be a good research opportunity for you. The first thing you can do is look through some of the existing literature on the Ottoman Empire and see what other scholars have said about it. Then we can start brainstorming ideas for the project. Okay, that sounds like a good place to start. How long do you think the project will take? If we get started soon, I think it would be feasible to finish within a few months. That would give us enough time to meet the deadline for the grant proposal. That shouldn’t be a problem. I can work on it full-time during summer break and then part-time during the fall semester. Perfect! Let’s aim to meet over the next two weeks to decide on a schedule for writing the different parts of the proposal in the next semester. Does that sound like a plan? Yeah, that sounds good to me!
